mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, memory_key, memory_value, source, updated_at FROM diet_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_user_memory (user_id, memory_key, memory_value, source, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{memoryKey}, #{memoryValue}, #{source}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE memory_value = VALUES(memory_value), source = VALUES(source), updated_at = NOW()
